package.name: genesis_policy
package.description: Runs the learned reach-to-grasp policy (right arm + Wuji Hand 2) on the Adam-U through ros2_control: a sim-free runtime (observation assembly, damped least-squares IK from the URDF with pinocchio, the scripted phase machine) and one rclpy node that streams single-point JointTrajectory messages to the right arm and right hand controllers at the policy rate, behind a safety wrapper (fence, step cap, joint clamp, stale refusals, dead-man, hand-effort abort). The actor is an ONNX file plus a YAML of level constants handed over from adam-rl (handoff/policy/NAME/); nothing here trains. See README.md for the handoff schema and the parameters.
